name: veterinary-interface
description: Veterinary clinic web application for managing animals and events

scripts.dev: node kill-ports.js && concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.start: node kill-ports.js && cd server && npm start
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:check:client && npm run lint:check:server

author: Netanel
